title: FreightOS event envelope (CloudEvents 1.0 compatible)
description: Operational override of the handoff envelope, authorised by ADR-0015 and ADR-0019. Three changes: (1) the single `authoritymode` attribute is replaced by `legalauthorityclass` + `operatingcontext`, because the handoff enum omitted facility_operator and autonomous_mobility and therefore made Horizon 1 custody events unemittable; (2) `legalentityid` is required except for system-scoped events, which must instead carry an authorized actor; (3) `purpose` is a required context attribute — ADR-0019 requirement 6 names it on every envelope, and OQ-20 records that the handoff schema set additionalProperties:false with no such attribute, so an envelope carrying one was invalid. Purpose is drawn from a closed vocabulary and is supplied by the trusted command or control-plane context, never by model output. Attribute names are all-lowercase because CloudEvents 1.0 requires context attribute names to be lowercase alphanumeric — this is spec compliance, not a naming inconsistency.

tenantid.description: System-scoped events use the designated system tenant 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

legalentityid.description: Required unless operatingcontext is `system`. See ADR-0015 rule 4.

legalauthorityclass.description: The regulatory posture FreightOS acts under. Never widened by operatingcontext.

operatingcontext.description: The operational surface. Never a substitute for legal authority.

actorid.description: The authorized actor. Mandatory for every event, and the sole compensating control when legalentityid is omitted under system scope.

purpose.description: Why the actor performed the operation. ADR-0019 requirement 6 and OQ-20. Closed vocabulary, mirrored by app.is_permitted_purpose in migration 0006 and by PURPOSES in packages/identity/src/purpose.ts. Supplied by the trusted command or control-plane context; model output may not author, widen, or select it.

policyversion.description: Policy pack version in force when the event was emitted (12_OBSERVABILITY correlation set).

allOf.description: ADR-0015 rule 4: legalentityid may be omitted only under explicit system scope with an authorized actor.
ADR-0015 rule 6: only these class/context pairings are legal. carrier_agent + brokerage is unrepresentable, which is what keeps the two planes separate.
